summary: community.docker docker_image/docker_image_export archive idempotency breaks with Docker 29's storage backend, whose image IDs don't match manifest.json.
questions: Why does docker_image archive always report changed with Docker 29?

answer_card.title: docker_image archive idempotency on Docker 29
answer_card.answer_md: Idempotency of archiving in `docker_image` and `docker_image_export` relies on backend image IDs matching the tarball's `manifest.json`. Docker 29's new default backend uses non-matching IDs, so idempotency **no longer works**.
